messages:
tam: Quick sync: finalizing the reference-arch + IaC templates we promised marketplace partners. Need to decide multi-cloud layout (single repo, per-cloud folders) and how we expose SKU labels.

liam: Suggest per-cloud folders under `ref-arch/` to keep provider pins isolated. We should standardize on `offer_labels` (vendor, family, arch, hw_series) instead of freeform tags.

anya: I'll prototype an `examples/marketplace-quickstart/` that contains both a terraform example and an ARM/Bicep snippet for Azure. For GCP we can include a Deployment Manager sample or keep Terraform only.

sam: Security check: make sure Key Vault/KMS references are optional and documented. Provide an example managed identity snippet and a minimal RBAC policy. We can't bake account numbers in examples.

liam: Packaging: CI should produce a `manifest.yaml` with all offer_labels and a `variants/` matrix for x86/arm64/GPU. The marketplace ingestion team asked for a single manifest per offer.

ci-bot: ci-bot: pipeline queued for branch `feat/marketplace-refarch`. Job: `ci/generate-manifest` (pending)

tam: Naming: use `compute_tier` for the input instead of `profile`. Compute tiers map to instance families in the docs. Also include `hw_series` var (e.g. "A100", "Ampere", "T4").

anya: Example Terraform snippet to add to README: ```hcl
module "redwood_marketplace_quickstart" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/ref-arch//examples/marketplace-quickstart/terraform"
  compute_tier = var.compute_tier
  hw_series = var.hw_series
  override_labels = var.override_labels
}
```

sam: Minimal RBAC example for Azure (conceptual): ```json
{"roleDefinitionName":"MarketplaceUploadRole","permissions":[{"actions":["Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/write","Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/read"]}],"assignableScopes":["/subscriptions/<SUB>/resourceGroups/<RG>"]}```

liam: For the GCP path include a small `scripts/generate_offer.sh` that queries the created resources and emits `manifest.yaml`. Keep it idempotent and support a `--dry-run` flag so partners can validate locally.

ci-bot: ci-bot: `ci/generate-manifest` started. Logs: "building manifest from variants matrix..."

tam: Testing plan: - lint and validate templates (terraform fmt/validate, bicep build) - run example deploy with smallest SKU - run `scripts/validate_manifest.py` to assert required labels - run destroy.

anya: I'll add a troubleshooting section for the common provider-version lock error and recommend `TF_PLUGIN_CACHE_DIR` and per-cloud provider workspaces.

liam: Timeline: internal preview on Thursday, partner preview next Wednesday. If CI finds manifest schema issues, push partner preview a week.

sam: Also add an audit checklist in the README: auth flows, key rotation guidance, and a link to the compliance runbook.

tam: Action items: Anya -> examples + scripts + PR; Sam -> RBAC snippets + audit checklist; Liam -> manifest schema and release comms; Tam -> coordinate partner preview and label naming.

ci-bot: ci-bot: `ci/generate-manifest` succeeded (job id: 11477). Artifacts: manifest.yaml, variants-report.txt

liam: Great. If anyone hits a packaging snag, flag it here and we'll do a 15m call.
